description: Cs₂Na₂SnGeF₁₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. Cs is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.09-3.22 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SnF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeF₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-37°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.47 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SnF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeF₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-41°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.49 Å. Sn is bonded to six F atoms to form SnF₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaF₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-41°. There are a spread of Sn-F bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.02 Å. Ge is bonded to six F atoms to form GeF₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaF₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-37°. There are a spread of Ge-F bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.86 Å. There are ten inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one Ge atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Sn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Ge atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing FCs₂NaGe tetrahedra. In the sixth F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Sn atom to form distorted corner-sharing FCs₂NaSn tetrahedra. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Ge atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one Ge atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Sn atom.
